notes.title: Developer Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hey there![/b][/p][p]I'll be using this space to share updates from time to time on the game's progress.[/p][p]Lately, I’ve been focused on improving the art and visual effects based on earlier feedback. It’s been a bit of a rollercoaster. The upside of being a solo developer/artist is that I get to experiment and have fun trying new things. The downside? I have to do [i]all[/i] the work myself.[/p][p]I also made what might have been a dumb (or maybe smart) decision to upgrade my project to a newer engine version. Thankfully, it didn’t explode! In fact, it has actually improved my workflow and sped up testing, though I did lose some initial time wrestling with bugs from the upgrade.[/p][p]Anyway, here’s a backdrop of some scenery I just created to give you a feel for how the art is shaping up. Hope you like it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506815/eb057aa166f8b4f1dfd772e003ec68d805de2625.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Rogue Drone Hunter...
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters!

We’re thrilled to finally introduce Rogue Drone Hunter, a unique fusion of real-time action roguelike and turn-based deckbuilding combat.  If you love intense bullet-hell action and deep card game strategy, this game is for you!

Playtests and other updates will be coming soon, so stay tuned for more updates:
